correctness.rationale: The exact neighbour-vote rule yields explicit set updates for even and odd n. Even n partitions into rows below, at, or above half occupancy. Odd n partitions into L,M,N,H; all 16 type combinations and their exact intersection boundaries are proved to enter fixed or two-cycle sets within three updates, with sharp witnesses. Direct combinatorial enumeration proves each periodic/depth formula. A distinct direct vertex-vote checker agrees with those formulas on all 349,504 labelled states for n=3..9; finite verification supports but is not substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural infinite graph family (two complete cliques joined by a perfect matching) receives a complete exact labelled attractor census and sharp transient-depth histogram. Most notably the two-row rook graph and complementary crown graph have exactly equal recurrent-state totals at every odd size, yet opposite fixed-versus-oscillatory distributions, which is not implied by generic symmetric threshold dynamics. All entry-depth strata are given by meaningful natural binomial formulas, and the three-step exceptional configurations have an explicit one-overlap combinatorial mechanism.
